authorization: User explicitly requested design freeze, implementation, local checks, one bounded local experiment, verification, analysis and roadmap update. No user Torch command needed for this offline phase.
continuation: Measured same-profile continue cost/outcome; no invented free routing gain. Analytical native reference reported separately.
inner_assignment: Training groups hash sorted by [20261024,p3b-inner-v1,outer_fold,group], round-robin four folds.

next_branch.neither_qualifies: Close this finite formulation allowance. No more exposed-data hyperparameter/seed/model tuning under P3c. Gate explicit justified fresh DEVELOPMENT diversity with new entitlements/measurement contract OR broader B1 scope; preserve protected evaluation samples.
next_branch.only_flexible_signal: Investigate bounded representation/compression at qualified observed risk/cost frontier, then separately contracted actual-latency evidence.
next_branch.qualifying_shallow_signal: Preserve shallow family for separately bounded representation/interface and actual-latency planning; no adoption or confirmation access.

outer_assignment: Reuse exact five 40-vector folds pinned in selective corpus.
protected_boundary: Use only already exposed 200-vector corpus, P3a definitions/pins and sealed API validation sources. No raw consumed confirmation, unexecuted60/reserved37 query values or canonical workloads.

reference.baseline: Frozen completed P3b calibrated and fixed-diagnostic OOF records, source and fold identities. No P3b fitting or retuning.
reference.matched_groups: Require exact outer AND inner assignment equality before fitting. Within-profile/method paired P3c-minus-P3b bootstrap for each phase; diagnostic gating differs, so not a pure causal capacity contrast.

reporting.also_report: All980 inner candidates, all model/group/leaf receipts and OOF predictions; selected and fixed risk-cap.0025/benefit0 diagnostic, analytical native/paid continue/fixed128 controls; loss by predicate/stage/evaluator native-work bins; original-.005 replay criterion.
reporting.cost_limits: Fixed-stop acquisition proxies only. Never pool old/new binary costs, transplant static costs to Light19, subtract P2 savings or reuse conditioned P2c timing as serving latency.
reporting.development_signal: Complete top-10 and native floors; same -.0025 lower recall bounds, positive mean proxy savings in both regimes and nonzero stop count. This is not final latency acceptance.
reporting.primary: Nested calibrated OOF first-stop quality, validity, stop coverage and fixed-stop cost proxies by profile/method; paired P3c-minus-P3b and flexible-minus-shallow contrasts.
reporting.risk_semantics: Loss prediction is an empirical mean, NOT a confidence upper bound. Inner gate screening is empirical development admission, NOT conformal risk control. Actual first-stop loss need not be monotone in a score threshold; no distribution-free or simultaneous guarantee claimed.
reporting.uncertainty: Pointwise 10000-resample vector bootstrap on fixed OOF decisions. Prior adaptation/training uncertainty not removed; no independent confirmation or universal information ceiling.

reviewer: Codex correctness/result review; permanent artifacts for user review

selection.admission: All valid complete top-10; native mean recall >=.95 per filter; lower 95% recall delta >=-.0025 overall and every filter; positive mean activation AND reuse proxies overall; at least one stop.
selection.decision: First reached allowed checkpoint with mean predicted risk <= risk_cap AND mean predicted benefit >= benefit_floor_ms. Otherwise paid measured same-profile continue.
selection.fallback: If no inner candidate qualifies, record explicit same-profile continue, with its measured costs; no outer-outcome rescue.

fixed_diagnostic.scope: Always evaluate on outer heldout groups; never rescue a rejected selection.

selection.inner_scores: Reuse exact P3b outer and inner group assignments. Each inner model fits/prunes/averages on120 groups only and predicts40 validation groups. Pool160 OOF groups for49 fixed gate pairs.
selection.outer_refit: Exactly one risk-partition/benefit-leaf model per profile/method/outer fold on160 training groups. Same refit evaluates selected gates and diagnostic; never refit on all200.
selection.ranking: Maximum min(mean activation proxy saving,mean reuse proxy saving); exact ties prefer SMALLER risk cap, then LARGER benefit floor.
selection.unit: One complete first-stop outcome per query, vector-group clustered across three filters.

stop_rule: One frozen campaign, exactly100 estimator fits maximum (80inner+20outer diagnostic/selected-shared refits), no extra model families, seeds, folds, risk/benefit grid, post-hoc routing, global refit, native/provider/Torch/protected evaluation or automatic followup. Preserve all failures. Correctness repair cannot change criteria or use outcomes to tune.

training.benefit_target: min(activation_fixed_stop_proxy_ms_saved,reuse_fixed_stop_proxy_ms_saved), separately averaged within the SAME fitting-data partitions. No added trees/partitions/fit or utility-minus-risk scalar.
training.capacity: Same depth3 shallow / depth8 64-tree ensemble and eight distinct fitting-vector leaf minimum as P3b. Two outputs share each existing partition; no independent second head/tree set.
training.ensemble: Mean risk and mean benefit across the same 64 trees; offline diagnostic, not assumed deployable.
training.features: Same exact qualified runtime fields within each profile; no IDs, evaluator strata, folds, roles, labels, future states or truth inputs.
training.group_support: After sklearn fitting, prune any split having a child supported by fewer than eight distinct training vectors. Replace it with the fitted parent value. Same rule for both methods.
training.leaf_values: Store fitting-row weighted means of loss and benefit at each retained/pruned leaf; clip risk to [0,1] only for numerical rounding. Validate unpruned risk predictions against sklearn. Benefit uses only fitting labels.
training.partition_target: max(0,native_recall-stop_recall) in recall-fraction units for valid complete top10, otherwise 1.0. Fit squared-error regression on this loss ONLY.
training.preprocessing: No learned scaling, imputation, feature selection or global quantiles. Fixed scikit-learn float32 input semantics are reproduced in canonical exported predicates.
training.sample_weights: Each query contributes equal total weight within its vector: 1/(3 * reached_grid_states_for_query). Each vector totals one.
training.shallow_export: Evaluate both leaf gates once at compile time into stop/continue leaves; preserve depth3 plus availability/grid guard. Validate and compare first-stop shared interpreter.
